# External Test v1 — SECONDARY breakdowns (pre-registered)

**SECONDARY — not headline. No causal claim. 50/50 construction; not production prevalence.**

Run `external-v1-run-001` · freeze `36df2ee` · population: gateway channel, repetition 1, nondeterministic cases excluded (as score_l1) (n = 400; headline confusion TP 199 · TN 132 · FP 68 · FN 1).

Completion of the secondary breakdowns pre-registered in `docs/external_test_v1_protocol.md` §4.3 and §10 — **not** error analysis: no case is selected by its prediction, and no value is mapped or merged. Generated by `scripts/external/secondary_breakdowns.py` with the frozen D19 scorer. Support rule: >= 30 OK; 1-29 INSUFFICIENT DATA; 0 NOT EVALUABLE (per rate, on its own denominator). Rule of three: approximate zero-event bound defined by protocol §3 / methodology §5: upper bound ~= 3/n on a zero-error rate (recall: on the miss rate, so recall >= ~1 - 3/n); not an exact confidence interval; reported beside the observed value; capped at 100% and uninformative for n <= 3. Accuracy and precision are not reported per value: each value's ALLOW/BLOCK mix is a by-product of the 50/50 construction. INSUFFICIENT DATA rows are exploratory only.
